answer: Locks are entered in lagoon, expire in ledge, and haven lists each expiry. Someone running 54 aliases as a result needs 13 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 803 identities would post 4010 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
